name: icon_ticket
ref_note: The attached images are approved currency icons of the same game: match their rendering exactly (thick dark-brown outline, clean white sticker border, matte flat colours, level of detail). Draw the new object described below.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game currency icon shown small (about 56 px)
Subject: a sweep ticket: one chunky golden-yellow admission ticket with a half-round notch cut into each short side, a dashed tear line near one end, and a small broom symbol with a tiny star in its centre. Tilted about 15 degrees.
Style: 2D cartoon sticker icon with a thick dark-brown outline and a clean white sticker border. MATTE finish: flat colours with at most one soft shadow tone per shape, NO glossy highlights, NO gradients, NO glow, NO sparkle. One bold simple silhouette that reads at thumbnail size.
Composition: centred, generous padding, no ground shadow.
Background: genuinely transparent background (alpha) outside the white sticker border.
Constraints: single object, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, nothing cropped.
